checks.ref: command:count=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$count" = "1" ] || { echo "expected exactly one active change under openspec/changes/, found $count"; exit 1; }

command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
outside=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v "^$change/" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$outside" ] || { echo "$outside"; echo "the specify stage writes only under $change/ - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: tasks.md task 5.3 cannot pass its own verification when tasks run in the order given. It removes `locations.deviceTimeZoneBadge` from en.json/ru.json and requires the grep `deviceTimeZoneBadge\|deviceTimeZoneLabel\|Your time zone…` over packages/client/src (*.ts/*.tsx/*.json) to print 'only lines of locations_here_mark_unit.steps.tsx and LocationRow.test.tsx', then `pnpm --filter @time-zones/client typecheck`. But `src/test/features/locations/steps/locations_device_time_zone_e2e.steps.ts:9` (`const BADGE_TEXT = englishLocale.locations.deviceTimeZoneBadge;`) is only rewritten later in task 6.1. The grep prints that line, and typecheck fails because tsconfig.app.json has `"include": ["src"]`. Move the E2E steps update into or before 5.3, or move 5.3 after 6.1.

tasks.md task 3.2 cannot pass its own verification step (`pnpm --filter @time-zones/client typecheck`). It replaces `deviceTimeZoneLabel` with `mark?` on the presenter's LocationRow type. Its list of fixtures to update omits `views/shared/LocationRow.test.tsx`, which declares `const row: LocationRowModel = { … deviceTimeZoneLabel: "", … }` (line 18) and calls `renderRow({ deviceTimeZoneLabel: BADGE_TEXT })` (lines 128/135/143). That file is only changed in task 4.2, so typecheck fails at 3.2 (tsconfig includes src). design.md itself counts '10 test files' while task 3.2 lists 9. Add LocationRow.test.tsx's fixture/badge block to 3.2, or drop typecheck from 3.2's verification.
